sections.changelog:
Added

  • Plugin scaffolding from MVweb boilerplate: entry point, constants, MVweb Hub menu integration, GitHub Updater bundling.
  • 5 custom database tables (`keywords`, `links`, `index`, `clusters`, `cluster_posts`) with `dbDelta` activator and welcome-redirect on activation.
  • Settings API integration with tabbed admin page (Dashboard, Keywords, Clusters, Reports, Settings, Help) and BEM-styled UI Kit.
  • Helper layer: option wrappers, supported-post-types resolver, Object Cache → Transients fallback cache, WPML/Polylang i18n adapter, simple class loader.
  • Background indexer with WP Cron, dirty-row tracking, transient lock, and per-batch reindexing of post content.
  • Content analyzer that extracts prominent words and word counts per post into the `_index` table.
  • Keyword manager (CRUD, synonyms, source tracking) plus editor metabox for per-post keyword editing.
  • Frontend linker that injects contextual links into `the_content` with per-post / per-paragraph / per-target caps and respects a global blacklist.
  • Shared DOM scanner used by linker and admin sweep.
  • "Read also" related-posts block via `the_content` filter and `[mvweb_related]` shortcode.
  • Topical relevance scoring for suggestions (prominent-word overlap from the `_index` table), shown as a score chip and used to rank the review table, the frontend linker and the related block.
  • Context snippet for every suggestion — the surrounding source prose with the matched anchor highlighted — persisted in `_links.context` and shown in the review table.
  • Three interlinking modes (manual / semi-automatic / automatic). Automatic mode auto-approves high-confidence pairs (`status='auto'`) guarded by a minimum-relevance threshold and a per-target inbound cap.
  • Keyword-suggestion filter: drops corpus-generic words (document-frequency / IDF) and instructional filler verbs so suggested anchors are distinctive nouns.
  • Bulk link manager UI for approving / rejecting auto-generated candidate links.
  • Pillar-cluster management: create / delete / add spoke / remove spoke / suggest spokes, plus health metrics (spoke count, spokes linking to pillar, orphan spokes).
  • One-click cluster interlinking presets on each cluster card — "Hub & spoke" (pillar links to every spoke and every spoke links back to the pillar) and "Reverse silo" (every spoke links up to the pillar, which is not diluted by outbound links). Each preset bulk-creates approved `_links` pairs for the whole cluster using the target's primary keyword; existing pairs and human decisions are never clobbered, and — as everywhere in the plugin — a pair only renders on the front end where that keyword actually occurs in the source prose.
  • Reports tab and Dashboard widget: orphan pages, broken internal links, keyword cannibalisation, crawl depth, link counters.
  • Anchor over-optimization report: flags target pages where the same exact anchor text repeats across many live links, plus an inline warning in the review table when an anchor already points to a target multiple times — helps diversify anchors and avoid over-optimisation penalties.
  • Internal-link click tracking (opt-out via a Settings toggle): a lightweight front-end beacon counts clicks on contextual links into a dedicated `clicks` table (aggregate counts only — no IP or personal data), surfaced as a "Link clicks" report. Closes the feedback loop on which internal links visitors actually use.
  • Search-query keyword import (Yandex Webmaster / Google Search Console): paste the queries a page ranks for into the editor metabox — or feed a CSV via `wp mvweb-sml keywords import-queries` — and the "growth point" filter (search position window + minimum impressions) turns the almost-ranking queries into keyword targets for interlinking. No OAuth, no external calls: the plugin never talks to the search engines, keeping the no-SaaS guarantee.
  • Sentence-level anchor editing in the review table: click words in the context snippet to build the anchor from the real surrounding prose. The scanner now wraps that exact phrase on the front end (instead of only the keyword), so multi-word anchors read naturally with no duplicated words. Gated so single-word / keyword-equal anchors are unchanged. Anchor edits now also flush the front-end cache.
  • Review table upgrades: Anchor and Score are now their own columns (the anchor stays inline-editable and carries the over-optimisation warning), the Score and Status headers sort on click (with a direction indicator, id as the stable tiebreaker), and a rows-per-page selector (25 / 50 / 100) is wired to the existing clamp.
  • Guided flow: the Dashboard shows a contextual "Next step" block that routes to the right tab (Settings when nothing is indexed, Keywords once it is) — closing the dead end after a reindex — and the Help Quick Start now walks the whole cycle from enable through review to monitoring.
  • Actionable orphan reports: each orphan row (Reports and Dashboard) links straight to that post's Smart Links metabox with a tooltip explaining that registering a keyword there makes other posts link to it — a one-click path from "orphan" to "fixed".
  • Cornerstone bonus (Settings, "Cornerstone bonus", 0 = off): suggestions that point at a cluster pillar get an additive relevance-score bonus, so cornerstone pages rank higher and gather more internal links (hub-and-spoke). Applied at sweep time on top of the topical-overlap score.
  • Per-paragraph link cap (Settings, "Max links per paragraph", 0 = no limit): the DOM scanner now counts inserted links per nearest block ancestor and stops once a paragraph reaches the cap, leaving remaining candidates free to land in other paragraphs. Complements the existing per-page cap and word-gap so a single block is never over-linked — the automatic-mode safeguard search engines expect against paragraph-level anchor stuffing.
  • Bulk actions over the whole filtered set, not just the visible page. The review table's "select all" now offers "Select all N matching rows" once more rows match than fit on a page; applying a bulk action then runs server-side across every matching row (capped per request, with the UI reporting when a run was capped so it can be repeated). The bulk-action menu also gains "Reset to pending" and "Delete", so a reviewer can clear or re-queue hundreds of suggestions in one step instead of approving 25 at a time. Every path keeps the same per-row `edit_post` authorisation and cache invalidation as the single-row actions.
  • Anchor rotation (Settings toggle, on by default): when the same exact anchor already points to a target more than a configurable number of times, the "Generate suggestions" sweep links a registered synonym instead — but only one that actually occurs in the source prose (morphology-aware), so the rendered link still reads naturally. This spreads anchor text across the site instead of piling identical exact-match phrases onto one destination, the pattern search engines flag as over-optimisation. Rotation only ever affects newly created pairs; approved links and human-edited anchors are never touched. Complements the anchor over-optimisation report, which now surfaces a problem the plugin can also prevent.
  • Taxonomy-term exclusions and a `nofollow` toggle in Settings: exclude every post filed under selected categories / tags / terms from automatic linking (a multi-select grouped by taxonomy, alongside the existing post-ID and URL-pattern blacklists), and optionally add `rel="nofollow"` to every inserted contextual link. The nofollow value is merged with the `noopener noreferrer` that a `_blank` target already emits. Removes two of the most common reasons editors avoid the automatic modes.
  • Posts-list column with per-post link counter.
  • SEO importer (Yoast / Rank Math focus keywords) and CSV import / export for keywords.
  • REST API namespace `mvweb-sml/v1` with four read-only endpoints: `/links/{post_id}`, `/orphans`, `/stats`, `/keywords/{post_id}`.
  • WP-CLI command set `wp mvweb-sml` with `reindex [--force]`, `stats`, `orphans [--format]`, `keywords list [--post]`, `keywords import --source`.
  • Extension hooks `mvweb_sml_links`, `mvweb_sml_keywords`, `mvweb_sml_post_types`, `mvweb_sml_excluded_elements`, `mvweb_sml_link_attributes`, `mvweb_sml_related_posts`, `mvweb_sml_rest_permission`, plus actions `mvweb_sml_before_links`, `mvweb_sml_after_links`, `mvweb_sml_index_complete`, `mvweb_sml_flush_post_cache`.
  • Localization: text domain `mvweb-smart-links`, English POT template and Russian (`ru_RU`) PO/MO translations.
  • README, CHANGELOG and `docs/plugins/mvweb-smart-links.md` technical documentation.
  • Ranking refinement for suggestions (Settings, both on by default): beyond the whole-number topical-overlap score, a bounded fractional tie-breaker now orders pairs that share the same number of prominent words. **Rarity (IDF)** favours pairs sharing distinctive topic words over corpus-generic ones (reusing the indexer's document-frequency map — one scan, shared with the keyword-suggestion filter), and **Position** gives a small bonus to links that land earlier in the prose (Reasonable Surfer). The refinement stays below 1, so the automatic-mode relevance threshold and the cornerstone bonus keep operating on the integer part exactly as before.
  • Cache invalidation on target changes: when a post is edited, published, unpublished or deleted, every source post that links *to* it now has its cached output flushed as well — the linker resolves each target's title and permalink at render time, so a change to the target would otherwise leave stale HTML cached against the sources until TTL expiry. Bounded per target, with a single full flush as the fallback for pathological fan-in.
  • Short read-through cache on the REST `/stats` endpoint (5-minute TTL) so external dashboards polling aggregate metrics no longer re-run the report queries on every request.
  • Manual mode now hides the "Generate suggestions" button on the Keywords tab (it is a semi-/automatic affordance) and shows a short pointer to the editor metabox instead — the review table itself stays available for reviewing any existing suggestions.
  • Active-mode badge in the sidebar, shown on every screen, so it is always clear whether the plugin is waiting for review (manual / semi-automatic) or acting on its own (automatic, highlighted).
  • Automatic-mode dry run on the Settings tab ("Preview auto-approvals"): a read-only preview that counts the pending suggestions clearing the confidence threshold — the pairs automatic mode would approve without review — and lists a scored sample. Nothing is changed, so the thresholds can be gauged before switching modes.

Changed

  • `Cluster_Manager::get_all()` no longer issues `2 + 3N` queries: pillar id and spoke ids are reused from the in-memory pivot map and health metrics are computed via a private `compute_health_from()` helper.
  • Admin UI migrated to the current MVweb Admin UI Kit (slate palette, Yoast-style sidebar layout): sidebar navigation, `.mvweb-block` sections, `.mvweb-form-row` fields, `.mvweb-alert`, `.mvweb-faq` help, and the brand logo in the MVweb Hub hero.
  • Schema migrations now run automatically on update via `Activator::maybe_upgrade()` (version-gated `dbDelta` on `admin_init`) instead of requiring a manual re-activation.
  • CSV streaming reuses the shared `mvweb_sml_csv_escape()` helper; the duplicate private escaper in the admin controller was removed.

Security

  • Nonce verification on every admin form and AJAX endpoint.
  • Capability checks (`manage_options` for settings, `edit_others_posts` for editors).
  • Input sanitisation and output escaping across admin and frontend.
  • Cluster AJAX endpoints (`delete`, `add_spoke`, `remove_spoke`, `suggest_spokes`, `create`) verify that the current user can edit the pillar post (IDOR hardening).
  • `add_spoke` / `remove_spoke` AJAX endpoints now also require `edit_post` on the spoke post itself, closing an IDOR that let a pillar editor attach or detach arbitrary posts.
  • `mvweb_sml_rest_permission` filter exposes REST authentication for customisation without patching core code.
  • `link_css_class` setting is sanitised through `sanitize_html_class` to block attribute injection.

Fixed

  • The "Read also" related block now honours the same source exclusions as the contextual linker — the per-post opt-out plus the post-ID, URL-pattern and taxonomy-term blacklists — through a shared `mvweb_sml_is_source_excluded()` helper. Previously the block only checked the opt-out and post-ID list, so a post excluded by URL pattern or term still received a related block.
  • Settings form rows collapse into a single column on narrow screens (≤782px), fixing the horizontal overflow of the field and multi-select controls on mobile widths.
  • Completed the Russian (and English) translations for the second development cycle — cluster presets, the click and anchor-over-optimisation reports, search-query import, the nofollow toggle and the term-exclusion control — so no plugin string falls back to English on a localized site.
  • Click-tracking beacon now records a click only for a pair the plugin would link — an approved/auto row in the `links` table or a manual target on the source post — instead of any two published posts. The nonce-less public endpoint can no longer be scripted to inflate counters or bloat the `clicks` table with arbitrary post pairs, and off-type posts are excluded by construction.
  • Sentence-level anchor wrap now locates the anchor occurrence that overlaps the current keyword match rather than the first occurrence in the text node. An earlier literal occurrence (e.g. inside a compound word) no longer defeats the overlap guard and leave the trailing words of a multi-word anchor duplicated in the sentence.
